working_hypotheses.wh_text: Cost and failure concentrate in a few high-volume, low-judgment sub-steps per layer
working_hypotheses.evidence_locations: All 6 stages each surface 2-4 PPs with quantified cost/freq anchors; e.g. PP1.2 33-73% FKTP ICD-10 error, PP5.2 Rp575.4B BPJS pending single month, PP3.1 250-500 staff-hours per 1000-employee campaign

working_hypotheses.wh_text: Automation feasibility is gated by input-data format, not process importance
working_hypotheses.evidence_locations: PP2.1 RC1-3 (PDF lab results), PP3.1 RC1 (no HL7/FHIR multi-lab channel), PP4.1 RC1 (template-only report architecture), PP5.1 RC1 (unstructured GL PDFs), Stage 6 PP6.1 RC1 (explicitly cross-references PP2.1+PP3.1 as same root cause)

working_hypotheses.wh_text: MCU report generation and results collation are manual-heavy and fragmented
working_hypotheses.evidence_locations: Stages 3+4 dedicated to this. Permata Cibubur 2025 IS evaluation cited as primary. 250-500 staff-hours collation + 220-500 person-hours report generation per 1,000-employee campaign

working_hypotheses.wh_text: Claims pre-auth and adjudication are rules-based yet manually executed
working_hypotheses.evidence_locations: Stage 5 most evidence-dense. PMCare 4.2M annual transactions, 1.3% denial; CodeBlue n=855 specialist survey; BPJS pending claims 19.6% Oct 2024 = Rp575.4B single month

working_hypotheses.wh_text: CDM recall and follow-up leak patients across every layer
working_hypotheses.evidence_locations: Strong at clinic layer (Stage 2 PP2.2: 37.8% JKN DM active attendance, 32% FKTPs at RPPT Level 4) and TPA layer (Stage 6 PP6.1: Naluri RCT). WEAK at MCU-to-CDM-enrolment leg (Stage 4 PP4.3 uses Singapore/France/Japan proxies for 30-60% leakage; ASSUMED-8 with zero ID/MY primary data)
working_hypotheses.deep_research_query: Indonesia Malaysia post-MCU follow-up compliance rate from Naluri, Prodia OHI, Pertamedika IHC, BookDoc OHC referral tracking longitudinal data

working_hypotheses.wh_text: Indonesia and Malaysia diverge sharply on readiness
working_hypotheses.evidence_locations: Stage 6 ID-vs-MY readiness matrix (6-row compare); sourced 5-factor verdict (Malaysia faster for employer CDM via PMCare/Naluri); Indonesia second-phase via PROLANIS
